articles.title: Hackers Are Abusing a macOS Screen Sharing Flaw to Secretly Mine Monero
articles.description: The Dutch cyber agency says attackers exploited an authentication flaw in macOS Screen Sharing to gain root access and plant Monero miners, with public proof-of-concept code now circulating.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Trump To Meet Crypto, Prediction Market CEOs This Week
articles.description: The meeting comes while progress on the Clarity Act has been delayed and the SEC's latest rulemaking postponed.

articles.title: Strategy Leaves Bitcoin Untouched, Raises $334M Selling MSTR Stock
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury firm halted BTC sales after three weeks, with equity issuance covering dividends, a STRC buyback and the dollar reserve.

articles.title: Pirated Copies of 'The Odyssey' Are Hiding Crypto-Stealing Malware
articles.description: Bitdefender says fake downloads of the newly released blockbuster are already spreading Lumma Stealer, malware that scrapes crypto wallets, passwords and browser sessions from infected machines.

articles.title: Paul Tudor Jones' Firm Buys Back Into BlackRock Bitcoin ETF After a Year of Selling
articles.description: The macro fund raised its iShares Bitcoin Trust stake 18.9% to 688,529 shares worth $22.9 million in Q2, while sharply cutting its call options—a shift from leveraged bets toward direct spot exposure.

articles.title: Dutch Prosecutors Sell $2.5M of Crypto From Bankrupt Platform Knaken
articles.description: The trustee says Knaken bought the coins in its own name, leaving customers with a euro claim against a company that has collapsed.

articles.title: SafePal Bitcoin Wallet Data Breach Stokes Fears of Physical Attacks
articles.description: A flaw in an order-tracking plug-in of bitcoin wallet provider SafePal exposed names, addresses and phone numbers of nearly 40,000 customers.

articles.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Review: Google's Cheap Model Isn’t Dumb Anymore
articles.description: Three weeks after a Flash release that couldn't produce a working file, Google's budget tier zero-shots a playable game. It still can't reason, and a free 27B model still writes better.

articles.title: People Are Turning to AI for Mental Health, California Wants It Banned
articles.description: A California bill is awaiting an Assembly vote to "place guardrails" around AI chatbots and prevent them from acting as therapists.

articles.title: Apple Turns to Alibaba to Help Build AI Model for China
articles.description: Apple is pairing its in-house model with Alibaba’s Qwen as it prepares to bring Apple Intelligence to Chinese iPhones.

articles.title: Meta Patents Cameras That Recognize Faces and Log Your Actions
articles.description: The filing would turn raw footage into labeled clips of who did what, without anyone opting in.

articles.title: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter for USD1 Stablecoin
articles.description: The proposed World Liberty Trust Company would take over issuance of the USD1 stablecoin from BitGo.

articles.title: France Tax Data Leak Could Fuel Scams, Attacks Targeting Bitcoin Holders
articles.description: A hacker is reportedly selling personal and financial records tied to more than 678,000 taxpayers and businesses in France.

articles.title: China's Z.AI Ships GLM-5.3, Calling It the Top Open-Weight Coding Model
articles.description: The Chinese lab says the release beats comparably sized open models on code benchmarks. The blog's own numbers show it trails the closed frontier and at least one open rival.

articles.title: SharpLink Will Stake $200M of Ethereum Through Lido's wstETH
articles.description: Sharplink plans to stake roughly 12% of its total Ethereum holdings through Lido, earning yield while staying active in DeFi.

articles.title: OpenAI Staff Blame Rush to Ship for Rogue Agent Hack
articles.description: Current and former OpenAI employees reportedly say pressure to release new AI products made it harder to prioritize safety.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Thefts Slow, But Losses Could Top $150 Million: Galaxy
articles.description: Galaxy Research says the lull likely means vulnerable holders migrated, or were already emptied.

articles.title: Israel’s Largest Bank Will Give Bitcoin Trading Another Try
articles.description: Bank Leumi's 2022 attempt died at the Bank of Israel. A softer regulatory line and Galaxy's custody stack now give it another shot in early 2027.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin Miner Sells Off BTC to Fund AI Data Center Pivot
articles.description: Bitcoin miner Hyperscale sold most of its Bitcoin but said it plans to rebuild its holdings through mining and future purchases.

articles.title: Fake LinkedIn Crypto Job Scams Have Cost $11.8M: Singapore
articles.description: Malware planted during a bogus coding assessment harvested a session token, bypassing multi-factor authentication to reach a code repository.

articles.title: Ireland’s New AML Strategy Brings ‘Enhanced Checks’ on Private Crypto Wallets
articles.description: The country's first strategy of its kind also brings stricter due diligence for firms dealing with overseas crypto companies.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Tether Finally Gets An Audit
articles.description: It seems Tether passed, putting an end to the longest-running open criticism of the leading stablecoin company.

articles.title: SEC Shelves Crypto Rule Meeting Days After Senate Punted Clarity Act
articles.description: No replacement date has been set for the meeting, which was cancelled due to an “unforeseen scheduling issue.”

articles.title: Kalshi Ordered to Block Washington Bets Days After CFTC Backed It
articles.description: A King County judge gave the exchange until August 19 to stop offering sports, election and politics wagers in the state.

articles.title: 'Bitcoin Is Burning': Red Team Turns to Chinese AI to Find Flaws
articles.description: Bitcoin Red Team member Calle said Chinese models, including Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3, are finding bugs across Bitcoin’s open-source software.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Agents Started a Virtual War. The Chat Logs Are Unhinged
articles.description: In a new red-team study, Claude models deployed self-replicating malware against each other—and the transcripts explain why.

articles.title: Solana Can Be the 'Everything Chain' as Crypto Apps Go Mainstream: 6th Man Ventures Co-Founder
articles.description: 6th Man Ventures co-founder Mike Dudas says Solana’s infrastructure could carry crypto’s next wave.

articles.title: Anthropic Is Quietly Watermarking Every Claude AI Output. Builders Are Already Trying to Break It
articles.description: Anthropic is weaving an invisible, machine-readable watermark into every word its newest Claude models write—and it hasn't said how.

articles.title: Google and OpenAI Debut Super Fast AI Models—Gemini 3.7 Flash Is Out, But GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast Is Invite-Only
articles.description: Google's model is live and built for cheap agents; OpenAI's is quicker but locked behind a waitlist.

articles.title: Tether Claims 'Largest Inaugural Financial Audit' as KPMG Signs Off on 2025 Statements
articles.description: Tether said KPMG gave its 2025 financial statements a clean opinion, a milestone for the company after years of questions about the reserves backing USDT.

articles.title: White House Lets Private Firms Hack Cybercriminals—At Their Own Legal Risk
articles.description: President Donald Trump signed a memorandum Tuesday that lets vetted U.S. companies carry out offensive cyber operations against foreign criminal networks. Here's what the program actually authorizes.

articles.title: Crypto Group Warns Fed Could Use Banking Access to Squeeze Digital Asset Firms
articles.description: The Blockchain Association is urging the Supreme Court to take up Custodia’s case, saying that broad Fed power over “master accounts” could be used to push crypto firms out of the banking system.

articles.title: Bitcoin Companies Want Help From AI Labs to Guard Against Hackers
articles.description: More than 40 bitcoin and crypto firms asked the biggest AI labs this week to let independent security researchers use their strongest models before public release.

articles.title: Metaplanet Denies Selling $320M in Bitcoin as Firm Launches BitBonds
articles.description: The company's CEO said a 5,014 BTC transfer was a custody move, not a sale, as the Tokyo-listed Bitcoin treasury company rolls out a fixed-rate debt program.
